physical_attributes.eyes: Large, expressive glossy black 'dot' eyes with double white sparkles
physical_attributes.mouth: Mischievous small smirk, showing one sharp pixelated tooth
physical_attributes.neck: Sleek white high-tech robotic neck with yellow fiber-optic lines
physical_attributes.features: Small black fruit-sticker tattoo on the cheek with a QR code

outfit.headwear: Yellow cyber-peel helmet parts framing the ears
outfit.jacket: Heavy puffer jacket made of 'living' bright yellow banana peel texture, matte finish
outfit.details: The jacket has green 'unripe' accents on the cuffs and collar. A holographic '$HASH' fruit sticker is glowing on the left shoulder. Wires looking like banana fibers connect the jacket to the body.

art_style.base: Modern pop-art cyberpunk, 2D flat vector illustration
art_style.lighting: Sunlight yellow top-down lighting, soft pastel shadows
art_style.branding_rules: Always include small floating 'banana-fly' drones. Use yellow and green gradients for tech elements. The vibe must be energetic and chaotic-good.

joy.mouth: Wide joyful grin, 'U' shaped, very happy

angry.mouth: Sharp 'V' shaped frown, bared small teeth

stability_guide.note: Этот блок НЕ заменяет твой промт, а только фиксирует детали, которые расплывались на баннерах. Всё остальное остаётся по-твоему.

pose_anchor.feet: Always flat on ground, shoulder-width apart, no tiptoe, no floating
pose_anchor.shoulders: Horizontal, symmetrical (no one higher than other)
pose_anchor.head: No tilt — chin level, face straight to camera

detail_locking.eye_sparkles: Both white dots always at 10:00 and 14:00 positions relative to pupil center
detail_locking.qr_code: Stuck to cheek — never bends, never pixelates, never rotates
detail_locking.helmet_ears: Always attached at same angle, no flapping
detail_locking.green_collar_accents: Strictly horizontal stripes, no perspective warp

forbidden_even_if_chaotic: one hand up one hand down
head tilted like a question mark
jacket wrinkles that change shape per banner

canvas_fit.16:9: Chest-up framing. Drones fly in sides.
canvas_fit.1:1: Full body. Ground line at 80% height.
